variant: Basic COBS with omitted terminal block after 0xFF
applicability: The encoder omits an empty final block after a full nonzero block and excludes the framing delimiter.
law: A full code block represents 254 nonzero bytes and implies no zero.
edge_cases: End one byte short of the block boundary, at the boundary, and one byte beyond it.

oracle.255: FF followed by the first 254 bytes, then 02 and the final byte.
oracle.derivation: Table I assigns code n to n−1 data bytes. The full-block exception and final-block optimization are in section III-B.

known_wrong_implementations: Insert an implicit interior zero after a full block.
